issue_context.title: AIP-84 Post Clear Task Instances
issue_context.body:
### Description

Currently the Post Clear Task Instances public endpoint is at `api_connexion/endpoints/task_instance_endpoint.py` under `post_clear_task_instances`. We need to migrate it to the `api_fastapi/views/public/task_instances.py` under a `post_clear_task_instances` or similar.

Features and functionality of the endpoint will remain unchanged.

### Use case/motivation

AIP-84 cWiki Link: https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/AIRFLOW/AIP-84+UI+REST+API

### Related issues

Related to: https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/42370

### Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [X] Yes I am willing to submit a PR!

### Code of Conduct

- [X] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
comments: I'm working on this, will raise a PR in the next couple of days.
Running late on this one, my apologies. Still working on it, will raise a PR soon.

review_comments:
For consistency with other `Collection` Datamodel, can you add `total_entries: int` as well please. (and in the response as well)

It's not here in the legacy one but I think it should be added to stay consistent with the rest of the API.
Done, added @pierrejeambrun. `total_entries` will just be the length of the `task_instances`, so it'll serve the purpose of consistency.

If you put the fixture at the `conftest.py` level, do you mind also using it in other tests, and replace.

Maybe `test_dag` in `test_dag_sources.py` can reuse this fixture:
```
@pytest.fixture
def test_dag(dagbag):
    return dagbag.dags[TEST_DAG_ID]
```
Yes this works, but if you don't mind, shall I pick this up in a separate PR? Have some other cleanup to do in tests so can do it together if that's okay.
I was wondering how this could pass. Just realized it's xfailed, thanks.
Yes there's this: `@pytest.mark.xfail(reason="permissions not implemented yet.")`
